final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), total_accounts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account), shares AS (SELECT ac.district_id, ac.account_count, CAST(ac.account_count AS REAL) / ta.total as share FROM account_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM shares WHERE share >= (SELECT DISTINCT share FROM shares ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) ORDER BY share DESC, district_id
